verdict.reasoning: Rendered printed page 876 (PDF p900) at 300 dpi. Figure D.14 shows: Entrance -> Set identifier-2 -> (join) -> Set identifier-5 -> (join) -> Execute specified set of statements -> Condition-2; Condition-2 False -> Augment identifier-5, whose line returns to the join above 'Execute specified set of statements'; Condition-2 True -> line right and down to Condition-1; Condition-1 True -> Exit; Condition-1 False -> Augment identifier-2, whose line returns to the join above 'Set identifier-5 to current FROM value'. The claim's pdf_says matches exactly. page-900.md holds only the box/label texts in sequence with no edges or arrows, so the two loop-back targets and the Condition-2 True -> Condition-1 edge are absent; the flattened sequence even implies the wrong flow (Augment identifier-5 followed by Condition-1). The topology of the loop is the figure's content (the TEST AFTER varying semantics it illustrates), so this is a genuine content loss, not formatting. Informative annex figure, so structural rather than normative is appropriate.
